text:
samir: noticed a small spike in onboarding tickets: users see duplicate terminal events and occasional scrambled chunks when token refresh happens mid-stream. repro on web + mobile sampleapps.
ivy: can you paste a minimal repro and any logs?
samir: repro: open sampleapp -> start stream -> force token refresh at ~40s. sometimes UI shows two "[DONE]" tokens or the text order looks wrong. logs: 
```
[2026-03-26T08:12:10Z] sse: connected (sid=zz9)
[2026-03-26T08:12:50Z] auth: refresh start
[2026-03-26T08:12:50Z] sse: recv event id=201 data="chunk A"
[2026-03-26T08:12:50Z] sse: recv event id=202 data="chunk B"
[2026-03-26T08:12:50Z] client: parse error: unexpected "\\n"
[2026-03-26T08:12:50Z] client: reconnect with Last-Event-ID=202
[2026-03-26T08:12:50Z] sse: recv event id=202 data="chunk B" // duplicate terminal-like
[2026-03-26T08:12:50Z] sse: recv event id=203 data="chunk C" // arrives after duplicate -> UI order looks off
```
nicole: parity issue: web sampleapp aborts the XHR on refresh; mobile lets it drain. also sdks differ in SSE parsing (web emits per data line, mobile waits for blank-line delimiter).
ivy: so root causes: abort-vs-wait race, parser semantics mismatch, and weak client dedupe.
samir: propose fixes:
- change sampleapps to avoid aborting in-flight stream on refresh; instead mark next connect for resume server-side.
- standardize SSE parsing across sdks: emit only on complete SSE event (headers + blank line).
- add short client dedupe window (2s) keyed by event id; fallback to checksum if id missing.
- server ticket: make resume handshake atomic so final event isn't re-emitted during resume.
- add telemetry: counter sse.resume.duplicate with sdk tag.
nicole: also add a tiny onboarding UX blurb: "If your stream reconnects while refreshing credentials, the app will resume and dedupe repeated messages." should cut support noise.
infra-bot: created ticket INF-4381: sse-resume-atomicity.
ux-bot: draft onboarding blurb added to KB: kb/onboarding-sse-resume.
ivy: i'll push a quick web sampleapp patch to stop aborting and add a unit test simulating mid-refresh. nicole, can you coordinate mobile parity?
nicole: yes, will update mobile parser and add e2e asserting single terminal event rendered.
samir: i'll add the dedupe heuristic to js/python sdks and a telemetry flag.
ivy: once patches hit staging let's run stress with jittered refresh across many concurrent streams.
samir: will watch telemetry for 24h after rollout. closing for now; reopen if staging metrics disagree. :white_check_mark:
